subject: Optimize runbook sync — 20m demo (usage-triggered)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Alyssa Green <alyssa@brightrun.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.inference, soojin_lee@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Optimize runbook sync — 20m demo (usage-triggered)

Hi Alyssa,

Congrats — I noticed BrightRun Labs crossed an inference-usage threshold this week in your self-serve org. That usually means there are quick wins we can show in 20 minutes to reduce per-token cost and smooth latency during spikes.

Would you be open to a short walkthrough focused on:
- Key batching and cache knobs that map directly to your observed sequence lengths
- Simple quantization recommendations for your most common model variant
- One quick configuration change we can validate together that often cuts cost 10–30%

I attached a one-page mutual action plan so we can align on outcomes. I have windows tomorrow and Thursday — here's a quick availability link if you want to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/ben-car/20min-demo-availability

If you'd prefer, reply with two times that work and I’ll send an invite.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: BrightRun-Mutual-Action-Plan.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Alyssa Green <alyssa@brightrun.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Optimize runbook sync — 20m demo (usage-triggered)

Thanks Ben — love the proactive reach. We definitely hit a burst on Tuesday when we ran our nightly ingestion and saw latency creep. A quick session would be great.

Can we move this to next week? My team is heads-down this afternoon. Also, please include our senior infra engineer so we can validate kernel/instance choices live: Marcos Ruiz (marcos@brightrun.ai).

Preferred windows: Monday or Wednesday (PDT) after 10:30am.

— Alyssa
Head of Product, BrightRun Labs
alyssa@brightrun.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.inference, soojin_lee@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Optimize runbook sync — 20m demo (usage-triggered)

Hi Alyssa (and Marcos) — great, thanks for looping Marcos in. Marcos — nice to e-meet you.

I've pushed a couple of Monday/Wednesday slots into Calendly that match Alyssa's windows. If one of these works you can grab it directly: https://calendly.com/ben-car/20min-demo-availability

Proposed agenda (keeps it tight):
- 5m: quick context & our observation of the spike
- 10m: hands-on changes we can make in your Dedicated/Hosted routing to reduce latency and cost
- 5m: next steps + quick rollback plan

Prep notes for Marcos: if you can have the job id or a short example trace available that shows the spike (or the model/config snapshot), that will let us test a kernel recommendation live. No need to share logs beforehand.

Attached is the mutual action plan that outlines success criteria and next steps. I’ll hold a tentative slot for Wednesday 11:00am PDT — if that works I’ll send the calendar invite with a short runbook and the meeting link. If you prefer a different time, pick anything from the Calendly link and I’ll update the invite.

Thanks — Ben

Attachment: BrightRun-Mutual-Action-Plan.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Marcos Ruiz <marcos@brightrun.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Alyssa Green <alyssa@brightrun.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Optimize runbook sync — 20m demo (usage-triggered)

Hi Ben — Wednesday 11:00am PDT works for me. I'll pull the trace and a model config (weights + sequence length stats) so we can try the kernel suggestion live.

If you want me to add a Slack channel or temporary S3 share for artifacts before the call, say the word. Otherwise, accept the calendar invite when you send it.

See you Wednesday — Marcos
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, BrightRun Labs
marcos@brightrun.ai
